education_requirements: Pursuing post-secondary education in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline
key_responsibilities: Providing real-time DevOps support through bug triage and troubleshooting
Developing code that meets TechInsights' coding standards while preserving design intent
Presenting and defending designs to senior Engineers for review and refinement
Facilitating knowledge transfer to and from development teams (particularly at sprint start)
Developing proof-of-concepts to validate pivotal design concepts and de-risk technical approaches

Design software systems that meet or exceed business requirements, including identifying technology stacks, designing for scale and security, mapping requirements to technologies, and defining failover paths
Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to deploy software systems in collaboration with CloudOps specialists
Review and provide feedback on Platform Architecture and Design, acting as a unifying force across teams and contributing to platform reliability and code quality
Implement PoC models to explore difficult technical challenges and present findings to development teams to ensure alignment
Implement front-end and back-end software solutions, working with development team knowledge resources and leveraging AI for efficient design and implementation
Review and verify technical proposals/specs from senior developers and coordinate with Engineering teams on technical investigations for buy/partner decisions
Document all intellectual property related to TechInsights' software platform and embody knowledge about how the platform works
Contribute to emitting telemetry and monitoring events to support platform observability and performance tracking
Provide real-time DevOps support, engage in technical problem-solving during platform situations, and work with development teams to correct bugs
Provide end-customer technical support during high-severity platform situations

company_research.recent_news: TechInsights forecasts the semiconductor industry will exceed $2 trillion by 2027. Learn how AI infrastructure, advanced packaging, memory demand, and compute innovation are reshaping the market.
company_research.culture_signals: High-growth company driven by high performance. Inclusive environment that prioritizes diversity, equity, and accessibility.
company_research.additional_context: TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry. Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets. Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform. They provide detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market intelligence, and expert commentary. Their customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence.
